## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing hero copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co. website.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | On the policy list (subscription terms) |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list (shipping policy) |
| "means most boxes ship free" | **Unproven.** Nothing in the policy says most orders pass £25. It is an implied statistic about order values. Also, we sell tins and tea bags, and "boxes" isn't a product term in the policy. |

**Regulated claims:** The delivery line touches price and offers. The free-delivery threshold is accurate and on the list, but "most boxes ship free" stretches it into a claim about typical basket size. That needs data we don't have.

**House style:** Warm, plain and unhurried, with no banned words and no AI tells. The score is about 92. The opening line is good.

**Disclosure:** Nothing needed. It is our own site copy, with no partnership, affiliate or AI-label trigger.

**Fixed (suggested edit, not yet applied):**
- Remove "means most boxes ship free". Suggested copy:
  > Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

**Needs a decision:**
- If the team wants to say most orders ship free, someone needs to supply order-value data and add it to the policy. Otherwise, use the version above.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Approval has to be for the final wording, so Sam should approve the corrected version, not this draft. Nothing has been approved yet, so it should not go live.
